package: IDL ALPHA ORDERS to canonical order 1.1
note: Production version before CHG-2026-0412 (no delivery window).
description: Act 5 Dev stage: the change CHG-2026-0412 (delivery window) is made here live. Version 1.0 (before CHG-2026-0412). Test build of the ALPHA inbound order flow for the IDL briefing demo. It receives an EDIFACT ORDERS D.96A message over HTTP POST and reads the order number, the order and delivery dates, the delivery point, the order lines and the currency. Units are translated to the IDL code list (CT to CS, PCE to EA) and GTINs are looked up to IDL SKUs from a fixed copy of the product master. The delivery point name and country come from a fixed lookup of the one known ALPHA delivery point. The result is the IDL canonical order 1.1 as JSON, handed back to the HTTP caller. The AS2 input and the ERP call of the demo flow are not part of this profile yet.
